```python
from seedemu import Emulator
from seedemu.layers import Base, EthereumService, Blockchain, ConsensusMechanism

# Create emulator base with 10 stub AS and 3 hosts per stub AS
emu = Emulator()
base = Base.makeEmulatorBaseWith10StubASAndHosts(hostsPerStub=3)
emu.addLayer(base)

# Create Ethereum service layer and sub-layer (blockchain)
eth_layer = EthereumService()
blockchain = Blockchain(name="pos")
blockchain.setConsensusMechanism(ConsensusMechanism.POS)
blockchain.setTerminalTotalDifficulty(30)
eth_layer.addBlockchain(blockchain)

# Helper to get all hosts
hosts = []
for asys in base.getAutonomousSystems():
    for host in asys.getHosts():
        hosts.append((asys, host))

# Assign special roles
beacon_setup_host = hosts[0][1]  # First host overall
boot_node_host = hosts[1][1]     # Second host overall

# Assign validators: hosts in AS 1 and AS 2 (index 0 and 1)
validator_hosts = []
for idx, (asys, host) in enumerate(hosts):
    if asys.getAsn() in [base.getStubs()[0].getAsn(), base.getStubs()[1].getAsn()]:
        validator_hosts.append(host)

# Create blockchain virtual nodes, docker labels, enable geth http, set roles, customize display names, bind vnodes
for idx, (asys, host) in enumerate(hosts):
    vnode_name = f"ethnode-{asys.getAsn()}-{host.getName()}"
    # Create blockchain virtual node
    vnode = eth_layer.installByBlockchain(blockchain.getName(), host)
    vnode.setDisplayName(f"Ethereum Node {asys.getAsn()}-{host.getName()}")
    # Set Docker container label
    vnode.setLabel(f"ethnode-{asys.getAsn()}-{host.getName()}")
    # Enable Geth HTTP and WS
    eth_layer.enableGethHttp(vnode)
    eth_layer.enableGethWs(vnode)
    # Bind virtual node to physical node
    vnode.bind(host)
    # Set roles
    if host == beacon_setup_host:
        eth_layer.setBeaconSetupNode(vnode)
        vnode.setDisplayName(f"BeaconSetupNode {asys.getAsn()}-{host.getName()}")
    elif host == boot_node_host:
        eth_layer.setBootNode(vnode)
        vnode.setDisplayName(f"BootNode {asys.getAsn()}-{host.getName()}")
    elif host in validator_hosts:
        eth_layer.enablePOSValidatorAtRunning(vnode)
        vnode.setDisplayName(f"Validator {asys.getAsn()}-{host.getName()}")

# Add Ethereum layer to emulator
emu.addLayer(eth_layer)

# Render and compile with Docker, internetMap and etherView enabled
emu.render()
emu.compile(
    docker=True,
    internetMap=True,
    etherView=True,
    outputDirectory='./output',
    override=True
)
```
